title: Butternut Squash & Sage Soup with Crème Fraîche
description: A silky blended butternut squash soup with red lentils, fresh sage, and a hint of nutmeg, made richer with 0% Greek yogurt and finished with a swirl of crème fraîche and crispy fried sage leaves. Built as a light side for garlic parmesan chicken skewers.
ingredients: 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra virgin olive oil
12 whole fresh sage leaves, for crisping
1 tbsp fresh sage, chopped (about 8 leaves), or 1 tsp dried rubbed sage
2 lb (900 g) butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1-inch cubes (from a ~3 lb whole squash)
1/2 cup (100 g) dry red lentils, rinsed
5 cups (1.25 L) low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
1 tsp salt, plus a pinch for the sage
6 tsp (30 g) 40% crème fraîche, for serving
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra virgin olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add 12 whole sage leaves in a single layer and fry 30–60 seconds until they stop sizzling and turn crisp. Lift them onto a paper towel, sprinkle with a pinch of salt, and leave the oil in the pot.
Add 1 diced medium onion (150 g), 2 chopped carrots (120 g), and 2 chopped celery ribs (80 g) to the sage oil. Cook 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Add 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chopped fresh sage (or 1 tsp dried rubbed sage), and 1/4 tsp nutmeg. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.

Add 2 lb (900 g) cubed butternut squash, 1/2 cup (100 g) rinsed red lentils, and 5 cups (1.25 L) low-sodium broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook 20 minutes until the squash is completely tender and the lentils have broken down.
Take the pot off the heat and blend the soup until smooth with an immersion blender, or in batches in a regular blender with the lid vented.
Put 1 cup (250 g) 0% Greek yogurt in a bowl and whisk in 1 ladle of the hot soup to temper it. Stir the tempered yogurt into the pot off the heat. Don't let the soup boil after this point.
Stir in 2 tsp (10 ml) lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon), 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Taste and adjust the salt.
Ladle into 6 bowls. Top each with 1 tsp (5 g) crème fraîche, 6 tsp (30 g) total, and swirl lightly with a spoon. Crumble 2 of the 12 crispy sage leaves over each bowl.
notes: Sized as a side, about 1.25 cups per bowl. The skewers carry the protein, and at ~5 g fat per bowl there's still room for the parmesan. The red lentils fully dissolve when blended, so the soup reads as pure squash. Chickpeas also work in place of the lentils (1 can, 540 ml, drained, with 4 cups broth instead of 5), but they blend slightly grainier. Measure the crème fraîche: each teaspoon is about 2 g fat. For deeper flavor, air fry the 2 lb (900 g) squash cubes at 400°F for 18–20 minutes, shaking halfway, until the edges brown. Then add them in step 4 and simmer 15 minutes so the lentils still cook through. Store the crispy sage and crème fraîche separately if making ahead. Reheat gently without boiling and thin with broth, since lentils thicken it in the fridge. Freezes for 3 months without the toppings.
